name: Navigation
description: Site navigation: an inline list with hover/focus submenus on wide screens and a toggle on narrow ones that opens a native popover drawer or a <details> dropdown. Submenus nest to any depth; the mega variant draws them as a column panel. Works without JavaScript; a small script (only when a menu has submenus) keeps aria-expanded true and lets Escape close a panel.

mobile.description: Narrow-screen menu: a side drawer (Popover API) or a dropdown under the toggle.

menu.description: How a submenu opens on wide screens: a list under the item (flyout) or a wide panel with one column per child and the grandchildren listed under it (mega).

align.description: Horizontal alignment of the inline list.

density.description: Gap and text size of the inline list.

color.description: current: the surrounding text, dimmed until hovered. link: the site's link colour (--color-link, else the accent) at full strength.

items.description: Menu entries; one level of children is shown.

label.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark (ui-strings nav.label).

menuLabel.description: Text of the narrow-screen toggle (ui-strings nav.menu).

closeLabel.description: Text of the drawer's close button (ui-strings nav.close).

id.description: Unique id when a page renders two navigations.

part.description: What the navigation is, for checks that find a page's parts (data-cr-part), e.g. "nav-header".

a11y: A <nav> landmark with a label; the current page carries aria-current. Each parent has a button (aria-controls its panel, labelled by the item) that opens the panel on hover and :focus-within; with the small script aria-expanded follows what is open and Escape closes the panel and returns focus to the button, as in the WAI-ARIA disclosure navigation pattern. Tab leaves a panel and closes it; nothing is hidden from crawlers (the panels are in the HTML). The drawer is a native popover: Escape and light dismiss close it and focus returns to the toggle.
